cifar.selection_rule: Within a dataset, pick the configuration with the highest mean selected-checkpoint validation accuracy over seeds; break ties by the lowest mean validation cross-entropy, then by the fewest parameters. The final model is the seed of that configuration ranked first by the checkpoint rule. Test metrics play no part in either choice.
